```{r fig-1d-fig-2a-viral-vOTU-richness-location-bird-order-viral-vOTU-richness-location-bird-order}
# Viral vOTU richness across locations and bird orders

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Input files

abundance_file <- "RPKM_allvirus_percent_matrix_clean.tsv"
location_file <- "location.xlsx"
eukaryotic_votu_file <- "veter_otus_clean.xlsx"
bird_file <- "bird_species.xlsx"


abu <- read.table(
  abundance_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

loc <- read_xlsx(location_file)
euk_ids <- read_xlsx(eukaryotic_votu_file)
bird <- read_xlsx(bird_file)

# Standardize column names
names(loc)[names(loc) == "ID"] <- "Library"
names(euk_ids)[1] <- "Contig"

# Assign missing bird orders to "Unknown"
bird$Order[is.na(bird$Order)] <- "Unknown"


abu_long <- abu %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Contig,
    names_to = "Library",
    values_to = "value"
  )


abu_meta <- abu_long %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "Library") %>%
  left_join(bird, by = "Library") %>%
  filter(!is.na(location))


abu_pa <- abu_meta %>%
  mutate(
    present = value > 0
  )


combo_votu <- abu_pa %>%
  group_by(location, Order, Contig) %>%
  summarise(
    any_present = any(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


votu_rich_combo <- combo_votu %>%
  group_by(location, Order) %>%
  summarise(
    votu_richness = sum(any_present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


sample_n_combo <- abu_meta %>%
  group_by(location, Order) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n_distinct(Library),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine vOTU richness and sample size
div_combo <- votu_rich_combo %>%
  left_join(
    sample_n_combo,
    by = c("location", "Order")
  )


p_bird_order <- ggplot(
  div_combo,
  aes(
    x = location,
    y = Order
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = votu_richness,
      fill = n_samples
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "vOTU richness"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = "Sample size",
    low = "lightblue",
    high = "darkblue"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Bird order",
    title = "Viral vOTU richness by location and bird order"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

p_bird_order
```

## fig.2b_heatmap: heatmap

```{r setup-fig-2b-heatmap-heatmap, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(figure_dir, "panels/fig.2b_heatmap"))
```

```{r fig-2b-heatmap-heatmap}
# Vertebrate-associated viral family heatmap

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Input files
abundance_file <- "RPKM_veter_percent_matrix_clean.tsv"
taxonomy_file <- "taxonomy.xlsx"
location_file <- "location.xlsx"


vmat <- read.table(
  abundance_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

tax <- read_xlsx(taxonomy_file)
loc <- read_xlsx(location_file)

# Standardize the location column name
names(loc)[names(loc) == "Location"] <- "location"


vmat2 <- vmat %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("Contig" = "ID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Family))


family_mat <- vmat2 %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), sum),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(family_mat) <- family_mat$Family

family_mat <- family_mat[
  , names(family_mat) != "Family",
  drop = FALSE
]


heatmat <- log10(family_mat + 1)


sample_ids <- colnames(heatmat)

ann_col <- data.frame(
  ID = sample_ids,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "ID")

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Location = ann_col$location
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- ann_col$ID


location_order <- c(
  "Aral, Xinjiang",
  "Beijing",
  "Chengdu, Sichuan",
  "Chifeng, Inner Mongolia",
  "Chongqing",
  "Guangzhou, Guangdong",
  "Haikou, Hainan",
  "Harbin, Heilongjiang",
  "Yining, Xinjiang",
  "Lanzhou, Gansu",
  "Nanjing, Jiangsu",
  "Nyingchi, Tibet",
  "Xining, Qinghai",
  "Shanghai",
  "Tai'an, Shandong",
  "Ürümqi, Xinjiang",
  "Wuhan, Hubei",
  "Xi'an, Shaanxi",
  "Xianyang, Shaanxi",
  "Yinchuan, Ningxia",
  "Zhengzhou, Henan",
  "Zhenjiang, Jiangsu"
)

annotation_col$Location <- factor(
  annotation_col$Location,
  levels = location_order
)


ord <- order(
  annotation_col$Location,
  rownames(annotation_col)
)

heatmat_ord <- heatmat[
  , ord,
  drop = FALSE
]

annotation_col_ord <- annotation_col[
  ord,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


pheatmap(
  heatmat_ord,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c("white", "deepskyblue", "lightsalmon")
  )(100),
  border_color = NA,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_ord,
  main = "Vertebrate-associated viral families (log10 RPKM + 1)"
)
```

## fig.2c_bird_order_virome_similarity_analysis: bird_order_virome_similarity_analysis

```{r setup-fig-2c-bird-order-virome-similarity-analysis-bird-order-virome-similarity-analysis, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(figure_dir, "panels/fig.2c_bird_order_virome_similarity_analysis"))
```

```{r fig-2c-bird-order-virome-similarity-analysis-bird-order-virome-similarity-analysis}
# Bird order virome similarity analysis

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(cowplot)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

# Input files

metadata_file <- "metadata.xlsx"
abundance_file <- "RPKM_veter_percent_matrix_clean.tsv"
taxonomy_file <- "veter_votus_clean.xlsx"


meta <- read_excel(metadata_file) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID = Library,
    BirdOrder = Order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = trimws(as.character(SampleID)),
    BirdOrder = trimws(as.character(BirdOrder)),
    SampleID = gsub("Birdfe", "BirdFe", SampleID)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SampleID),
    SampleID != "",
    !is.na(BirdOrder),
    BirdOrder != ""
  )


abu <- read.table(
  abundance_file,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(abu)[1] <- "vOTU"

# Standardize sample IDs
colnames(abu) <- gsub(
  "Birdfe",
  "BirdFe",
  colnames(abu)
)


samples_in_abu <- colnames(abu)[-1]
samples_in_meta <- meta$SampleID

shared_samples <- intersect(
  samples_in_abu,
  samples_in_meta
)

abu2 <- abu[
  ,
  c("vOTU", shared_samples),
  drop = FALSE
]

meta2 <- meta %>%
  filter(
    SampleID %in% shared_samples
  )


tax <- read_excel(taxonomy_file) %>%
  rename(
    vOTU = votus
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vOTU = trimws(as.character(vOTU)),
    Family = trimws(as.character(Family))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(vOTU),
    vOTU != "",
    !is.na(Family),
    Family != ""
  )


abu_fam_long <- abu2 %>%
  left_join(
    tax,
    by = "vOTU"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Family)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(vOTU, Family),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Family,
    SampleID
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(
      Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert to a Sample x Family matrix
fam_sample <- abu_fam_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = Abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )


fam_sample2 <- fam_sample %>%
  left_join(
    meta2,
    by = "SampleID"
  )


order_counts <- meta2 %>%
  count(
    BirdOrder,
    sort = TRUE
  )

keep_orders <- order_counts %>%
  filter(
    n > 10
  ) %>%
  pull(
    BirdOrder
  )


order_centroid <- fam_sample2 %>%
  filter(
    BirdOrder %in% keep_orders
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    BirdOrder
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

order_mat <- as.data.frame(
  order_centroid
)

rownames(order_mat) <- order_mat$BirdOrder
order_mat$BirdOrder <- NULL


dist_bc <- vegdist(
  order_mat,
  method = "bray"
)

sim_mat <- 1 - as.matrix(
  dist_bc
)


pheatmap(
  sim_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "#81c1e8",
      "#e6e6e6",
      "#dc9c7b"
    )
  )(100),
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Bird order virome similarity (1 - Bray-Curtis)"
)


order_long <- order_mat %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "BirdOrder"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -BirdOrder,
    names_to = "Family",
    values_to = "Percent"
  )


plot_pair_stacked_top5 <- function(
    orderA,
    orderB,
    sim_value,
    top_k = 5,
    show_legend = FALSE
) {
  
  df_pair <- order_long %>%
    filter(
      BirdOrder %in% c(
        orderA,
        orderB
      )
    )
  
  top_fams <- df_pair %>%
    group_by(
      Family
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      rank_value = max(
        Percent,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(rank_value)
    ) %>%
    slice_head(
      n = top_k
    ) %>%
    pull(
      Family
    )
  
  df_plot <- df_pair %>%
    mutate(
      Family_group = ifelse(
        Family %in% top_fams,
        Family,
        "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      BirdOrder,
      Family_group
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Percent = sum(
        Percent,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      BirdOrder = factor(
        BirdOrder,
        levels = c(
          orderA,
          orderB
        )
      ),
      Family_group = factor(
        Family_group,
        levels = c(
          top_fams,
          "Other"
        )
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = BirdOrder,
      y = Percent,
      fill = Family_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 10
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (
        show_legend
      ) "bottom" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 9
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean abundance (%)",
      fill = "Viral family",
      title = paste0(
        orderA,
        " vs ",
        orderB
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Similarity = ",
        round(
          sim_value,
          3
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0.05
        )
      )
    )
}


pairs_all <- as.data.frame(
  sim_mat
) %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "Order1"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Order1,
    names_to = "Order2",
    values_to = "Similarity"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Order1 < Order2
  )


N <- 5

top_pairs <- pairs_all %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Similarity)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = N
  )

bottom_pairs <- pairs_all %>%
  arrange(
    Similarity
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = N
  )


plots_top <- pmap(
  top_pairs,
  function(
    Order1,
    Order2,
    Similarity
  ) {
    
    plot_pair_stacked_top5(
      Order1,
      Order2,
      Similarity,
      top_k = 5,
      show_legend = FALSE
    )
  }
)

plots_bottom <- pmap(
  bottom_pairs,
  function(
    Order1,
    Order2,
    Similarity
  ) {
    
    plot_pair_stacked_top5(
      Order1,
      Order2,
      Similarity,
      top_k = 5,
      show_legend = FALSE
    )
  }
)

plots_10 <- c(
  plots_top,
  plots_bottom
)


grid_panels <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = plots_10,
  ncol = 5,
  nrow = 2,
  align = "hv"
)

title_grob <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label(
    "Viral family composition of representative bird order pairs",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 14,
    x = 0,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_label(
    "Top row: five most similar pairs; Bottom row: five most dissimilar pairs",
    size = 11,
    x = 0,
    y = 0.55,
    hjust = 0
  )

fig_pairwise <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  title_grob,
  grid_panels,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(
    0.12,
    1
  )
)

fig_pairwise


node_df <- order_counts %>%
  filter(
    BirdOrder %in% keep_orders
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    name = BirdOrder,
    n_samples = n
  )

ord <- node_df$name

sim_use <- sim_mat[
  ord,
  ord,
  drop = FALSE
]


edges_all <- as.data.frame(
  sim_use
) %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "from"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -from,
    names_to = "to",
    values_to = "weight"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    from < to
  )


thr <- as.numeric(
  quantile(
    edges_all$weight,
    probs = 0.75,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

edges_keep <- edges_all %>%
  filter(
    weight >= thr
  )


g_thr <- graph_from_data_frame(
  edges_keep,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = node_df
)

g_full <- graph_from_data_frame(
  edges_all,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = node_df
)


mst_g <- mst(
  g_full,
  weights = -E(g_full)$weight
)

# Combine high-similarity edges with the maximum
# spanning tree to maintain network connectivity
g <- igraph::union(
  g_thr,
  mst_g
)


edge_key <- edges_all %>%
  mutate(
    key = paste(
      pmin(
        from,
        to
      ),
      pmax(
        from,
        to
      ),
      sep = "__"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    key,
    weight
  )

edge_ends <- ends(
  g,
  E(g)
)

E(g)$key <- paste(
  pmin(
    edge_ends[, 1],
    edge_ends[, 2]
  ),
  pmax(
    edge_ends[, 1],
    edge_ends[, 2]
  ),
  sep = "__"
)

E(g)$weight <- edge_key$weight[
  match(
    E(g)$key,
    edge_key$key
  )
]


name_to_n <- setNames(
  node_df$n_samples,
  node_df$name
)

V(g)$n_samples <- unname(
  name_to_n[
    V(g)$name
  ]
)


weight_range <- range(
  edges_all$weight,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

sample_range <- range(
  node_df$n_samples,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

weight_breaks <- round(
  pretty(
    weight_range,
    n = 4
  ),
  2
)

weight_breaks <- weight_breaks[
  weight_breaks >= weight_range[1] &
    weight_breaks <= weight_range[2]
]

sample_breaks <- pretty(
  sample_range,
  n = 4
)


tg <- as_tbl_graph(
  g
)

set.seed(123)

p_network <- ggraph(
  tg,
  layout = "fr"
) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      width = weight,
      colour = weight
    ),
    alpha = 0.85,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(
    range = c(
      0.3,
      3.2
    ),
    breaks = weight_breaks,
    name = "Similarity\n(1 - Bray-Curtis)"
  ) +
  scale_edge_colour_gradient(
    low = "grey80",
    high = "#b2182b",
    breaks = weight_breaks,
    name = "Similarity\n(1 - Bray-Curtis)"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(
      size = n_samples
    ),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 10,
    breaks = sample_breaks,
    name = "Samples\n(n)"
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(
      label = name
    ),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Network of vertebrate-associated virome similarity across bird orders",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Edges shown: similarity >= ",
      round(
        thr,
        3
      ),
      " (top 25%) + maximum spanning tree"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10
    )
  )

p_network
```
